name: Kericho Open 2023

venue.name: A.C.K. Grace Conference Centre
venue.address: A.C.K. Grace Conference Centre, Kericho, Kenya

information: Welcome! This will be the first WCA competition we will have in Kericho... and we will plan on organising many more in the future. We will be glad to see all the cubers from around this region, and you'll all have a great time. More information under their respective tabs.
